Times Music presents ‘Rain Story’, a beautiful Hindi romantic song sung by Debattama, with music by Suhit Abhyankar. From shy glances and a first conversation to little fights, and a love that grows with time, Rain Story captures the feeling of falling in love with your childhood sweetheart.
